addr: 27th main, 26th Cross, Sector 2, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: Tucked away in the quiet streets of JSR LAYOUT, this is a pretty large wedding hall. Some parking is available on ground floor and in the basement.

I visited this center for a wedding reception yesterday evening. It's a nice venue that can accommodate a crowd of 300 pax, dining hall is also good. Need to climb about 15 steps to enter the banquet hall. The area for car parking is …

Edit 1: Looks like the place has lift from parking area. Day when I have visited, I saw elderly climbing stairs and lift was not visible from the gate entrance. Hence I have mentioned , no lift facility. …
